name: API-Bench-TensorflowHub
description: A code / API-usage benchmark that measures a model's ability to generate correct TensorFlow Hub API calls and related code snippets. Tasks involve producing valid usage patterns, correct function signatures, and working code that integrates TensorFlow Hub modules. Evaluation focuses on functional correctness of produced code and API conformance.
reputation: A specialized, lower-profile benchmark aimed at API usage and code-generation evaluation; used primarily by practitioners evaluating ML-code capability.
